_doc: Motif store AND axis bank. `bank` holds every direction ever kept, keyed by the ax_<hex> content hash of that direction in label_anchors.npz: positive/negative name either tail's motif (null = unnamed; an unnamed axis is shipped and used, the client just says nothing about it), and `comment` records where it came from and what is known to be wrong with it. `components` IS THE AXIS BANK: an ordered list of those ids, the first K_AXES of which pipeline.train_mirt teaches its axes onto, in axis order. Binding by id rather than by column position is the point — a separate bank file orders directions implicitly and this file is indexed against that order, so reordering it renames every motif onto a direction it was not written for. Edit names and components here; add directions with auxiliary.rating_dev.update_motif_store, never by hand.

NEVER CONVERGED UNDER THE CURRENT train_mirt, so it is a candidate seed rather than a measured motif — the two-stage axes were fitted against a frozen 4PL and their directions are not comparable with a joint fit's without a refit. Covers 149508 of 160489 problems; the remainder postdate it and are NaN.

ax_df8b6188.comment: Joint MIRT, ortho-b seed 1 (2026-08-17), taught from a rule-free control axis and re-fitted under the difficulty-orthogonality penalty. Discovered by the FREE control fit (no bank), then carried. Clean on difficulty (+0.02) but displaced onto the floor head (-0.43) by the b-only penalty; the residual leak of the adopted configuration.

ax_b3b25f28.comment: Joint MIRT, ortho-b seed 1 (2026-08-17). Seeded from a hand-written rule (>=5 stones changing life status, no comparable counter-trade). SUSPECT NAME: least reproducible motif measured (cross-fit r +0.45 against +0.84 for ko), and slope-entangled in every arm (-0.56 here, -0.68 at decay 500, +0.79 in the bipolar arm). It drains toward the discrimination head whenever teaching is released early, which is what a direction that is not really a motif does. Verify the extremes before shipping this name.

ax_030cdf1c.comment: Joint MIRT, ortho-b seed 1 (2026-08-17). Seeded from a rule (ko detected on the board after the solution). The most reproducible motif measured: cross-fit r +0.84, retention +0.91 across a seed change, and clean on every rating parameter except a mild floor correlation (-0.28).

ax_cadba465.comment: Joint MIRT, FREE control fit seed 0 (2026-08-16), axis 1 — discovered rather than seeded, named by eyeballing its extremes. The only instance in existence, so it is unvalidated by reproduction: no second fit has been asked to find it. Clean on difficulty (+0.05).

ax_87738d52.comment: Joint MIRT, rule-seeded drop_ko arm seed 0 (2026-08-16). Seeded from a rule (score gap under 5 points with winrate over 90 percent). Cleanest of its three instances on difficulty (+0.03); moderate reproducibility (cross-fit r +0.59).

ax_e619efa1.comment: Joint MIRT, rule-seeded drop_ko arm seed 0 (2026-08-16). Seeded from a rule (earliest 5 percent of game phase). Highly reproducible (cross-fit r +0.83) but DIFFICULTY-LADEN IN EVERY INSTANCE MEASURED (-0.30 to -0.34); this is the least-bad of the three. Teaching from it re-injects difficulty into the axes unless the ortho penalty is on.

ax_4e23f75b.comment: Joint MIRT, FREE fit seed 1 (2026-08-17) under the FULL rating-orthogonality penalty (rating+slope+floor), axis 0 positive tail. Discovered rather than seeded, named by eyeballing the extremes capped at 1d. RATING-ORTHOGONAL BY CONSTRUCTION (b +0.08, rating +0.07, slope +0.03, floor +0.01), which is what makes it a valid bank seed under that penalty where the b-only motifs are not. SHARES A NAME BUT NOT A DIRECTION with ax_cadba465: tail agreement between the two is -0.018, i.e. unrelated. The same Go concept read off a slice orthogonal to the rating parameters selects different problems; do not treat them as one motif.

ax_2091d5bf.comment: Joint MIRT, FREE fit seed 1 (2026-08-17) under the FULL rating-orthogonality penalty, axis 1 positive tail. Discovered rather than seeded, named by eyeballing the extremes capped at 1d. Rating-orthogonal by construction (b +0.13, rating +0.09, slope +0.04, floor +0.01). NEW MOTIF: agrees with nothing else in the store above 0.064, so it is not a re-finding of any earlier direction under a different name.

ax_4cb94a2c.comment: Joint MIRT, FREE fit seed 1 (2026-08-17) under the FULL rating-orthogonality penalty, axis 2 NEGATIVE tail — the positive tail is unnamed and ships silently. Named by eyeballing the extremes capped at 1d. Rating-orthogonal by construction (b +0.03, rating -0.02, slope +0.01, floor -0.01). PARTIALLY overlaps ax_df8b6188 of the same name (tail agreement +0.309): related but not the same direction, the b-only version carrying floor -0.22 that this one does not.
